glossentry.glossdef: An extensible Semantic Web Browser developed by the Haystack research group at the MIT Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (http://haystack.lcs.mit.edu). The project explores how the Semantic Web data model (a Resource Description Framework — RDF) can be applied by users to better organize, navigate, and retrieve information, both personal and shared (www.w3.org/2005/04/swls/BioDash/Demo/What is Haystack.html).
